description: Residential Solar Investment Program (RSIP) Enrollment is a dataset listed in State of Connecticut open data portal (data.ct.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Connecticut. Through the Residential Solar Investment Program (RSIP), the Connecticut Green Bank, in partnership with a network of contractors and inspectors, helped more than 46,300 households access solar energy since 2012, surpassing the statutory target of 350 MW (reaching 378 MW) one year ahead of the December 2022 deadline. Coverage: Connecticut. The portal files it under the category Environment and Natural Resources. Its tags are connecticut green bank, ct green bank, solar, renewable. The table has 22 columns. Attribution on the portal: Connecticut Green Bank. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ct-gov-portal.
